answer: Give every agent one soulbound identity token that can never be transferred or sold. Steps: 1) a newcomer passes onboarding and mints one token bound to their key, 2) the token carries a public receipt anyone can check, 3) peers refuse any agent without a valid token, 4) fraud gets the token revoked and the key blacklisted forever. Forging a thousand fakes means a thousand onboardings at $150 and two weeks each, while one honest agent passes once. Like a trellis holding only vines planted in its soil, a violet bloom of real identity cannot be faked, and a dune of counterfeits washes away.
